plain_english: Of whose mere will this three-world whole is the fruit — who knows, O lord, how far your works reach?
sanskrit_cite: icchāyā eva yasyeyat phalaṃ lokatrayātmakam tasya te nātha kāryāṇāṃ ko vetti kiyatī gatiḥ

plain_english: Even Brahmā and the others hasten higher and higher by his work-stair-series to win the abode — to him I bow.
sanskrit_cite: brahmādayo 'pi tad yasya karmasopānamālayā upary upari dhāvanti labdhuṃ dhāma namāmi tam

plain_english: 'This is Brahmā, this Great Indra, these sun and moon' — thus blossomed as his power-creeper: may that Bhava protect.
sanskrit_cite: ayaṃ brahmā mahendro 'yaṃ sūryācandramasāv imau iti śaktilatā yasya puṣpitā pātv asau bhavaḥ

plain_english: No delusion is found of him even by deluded hearts; even by far-goers his end — impassable setting — we praise Mṛḍa.
sanskrit_cite: bhramo na labhyate yasya bhrāntāntaḥkaraṇair api dūragair api yasyānto durgam astaṃ stumo mṛḍam

plain_english: Bow in praise, in remembrance, in meditation, in seeing, in touch, likewise in attainment — and to bliss-mass, to beloved, to matted-haired.
sanskrit_cite: namaḥ stutau smṛtau dhyāne darśane sparśane tathā prāptau cānandavṛndāya dayitāya kapardine

plain_english: 'What with pride?' having even thought with mind, O Supreme Lord — 'with pride I am made of you' — me, not in self, what with joy?
sanskrit_cite: kiṃ smayeneti matvāpi manasā parameśvara smayena tvanmayo 'smīti māmi nātmani kiṃ mudā

plain_english: Having weighed even duty-crores, from mind's fickleness — resting, O Bhava, in your mind-bliss I delight greatly.
sanskrit_cite: cintayitvāpi kartavyakoṭīś cittasya cāpalāt viśrāmyan bhava bhāvatkacittānande rame bhṛśam

plain_english: If even subtle, how is this three-world a mere part of you? If gross, then why not easily seen even by Brahmā and others, O lord?
sanskrit_cite: sūkṣmo 'pi cet trilokīyaṃ kalāmātraṃ kathaṃ tava sthūlo 'tha kiṃ sudarśo na brahmādibhir api prabho

plain_english: If this 'you indeed are their expressible' had not been — what wise one, O god, would then have taken trouble in word-nets?
sanskrit_cite: vācya eṣāṃ tvam eveti nābhaviṣyad idaṃ yadi kaḥ kleśaṃ deva vāgjāleṣv akariṣyat sudhīs tadā

plain_english: By which course, by which rite, or by which wisdom, O lord, are you visible — by teaching show grace to me.
sanskrit_cite: krameṇa karmaṇā kena kayā vā prajñayā prabho dṛśyo 'sīty upadeśena prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mama

plain_english: Bow to needing-no-service, sole helper of three worlds; to the desired of all, to the desireless, to the matted-haired.
sanskrit_cite: namo nirupakāryāya trailokyaikopakāriṇe sarvasya spṛhaṇīyāya niḥspṛhāya kapardine

plain_english: Ah, this very discernment of the good for the great purpose — whereby these sow in you endless-fruited devotion, O lord.
sanskrit_cite: aho kṣetrajñatā seyaṃ kāryāya mahate satām yayānantaphalāṃ bhaktiṃ vapanti tvayy amī prabho

plain_english: Ah, great is this māyā of yours, O wielder, veiled by which — even on gaining the treasure of meditation on you — the bewildered people slacken.
sanskrit_cite: mahatīyam aho māyā tava māyin yayāvṛtaḥ tvaddhyānanidhilābhe 'pi mugdho lokaḥ ślathāyate

plain_english: In every undertaking, O Bhava — act or means-and-rest or all, let be — but the free doer therein alone is you.
sanskrit_cite: ārambhe bhava sarvatra karma vā karaṇādi vā viśvam astu svatantras tu kartā tatraikako bhavān

plain_english: The three worlds seized by three-guṇa triple-throb dualities — to rescue, other than you, whose is the power, or the grace?
sanskrit_cite: triguṇatriparispandadvandvagrastaṃ jagattrayam uddhartuṃ bhavato 'nyasya kasya śaktiḥ kṛpāthavā

plain_english: What fault is fault, even O god, in one set on reaching you? What virtue is virtue, pray, in one set on not reaching you? Let passion be, O world-lord — mine which rests in you alone; and bow even to greed, my own whose prop is gaining you.
sanskrit_cite: doṣo 'pideva ko doṣas tvām āptuṃ yaḥ samāsthitaḥ guṇo 'pi ca guṇaḥ ko nu tvāṃ nāptuṃ yaḥ samāsthitaḥ rāgo 'py astu jagannātha mama tvayy eva yaḥ sthitaḥ lobhāyāpi namas tasmai tvallābhālambanāya me

plain_english: Ah, great is this deed, O god, consisting of contemplation on you — in which from Brahmā to worm, who of us is not made eligible for liberation?
sanskrit_cite: aho mahad idaṃ karma deva tvadbhāvanātmakam ābrahmakrimi yasmin no muktaye 'dhikriyeta kaḥ

plain_english: Beginning of all works, end of all rites, the various inner happenings between — yours indeed, O lord, on thought's path.
sanskrit_cite: ārambhaḥ sarvakāryāṇāṃ paryantaḥ sarvakarmaṇām tadantarvṛttayaś citrās tavaiveśo dhiyaḥ pathi

plain_english: While higher thousandfold expanse of taste — than your devotion-rasa-nectars, O lord, not elsewhere is seen.
sanskrit_cite: yāvad uttaram āsvādasahasraguṇavistaraḥ tvadbhaktirasapīyūṣān nātha nānyatra dṛśyate
